family_summary: Across the 28 sites, AI-built pages typically replace heavy, plugin- or CMS-generated markup with lean, hand-written semantic HTML: a single inline stylesheet, few custom classes, structured heading outlines, landmark elements, descriptive alt text, and minimal head metadata with lang set.

attributes.summary: On nearly all sites the DOM is slimmed from heavy CMS, plugin or div-laden markup to minimal markup with few custom classes and a single inline stylesheet in place of many scripts and stylesheets.
